landing.headline: Know what to learn, why it matters, and what to do next.
landing.sub: Upload your syllabus — even a photo — and NextChapter builds a roadmap, explains each topic from your own materials, schedules revision, and helps you grow towards your goals.
landing.f1Body: Photos, PDFs or pasted text become a clear, editable plan with prerequisites and effort.
landing.f2Body: Explanations link back to the exact page or timestamp, with practice matched to your exam.
landing.f3Body: A realistic calendar, a private journal, honest progress and India-focused opportunities.
landing.for: For school, college and competitive-exam students
